entities.name: Amayak Zaharovich Kobulov
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Amayak Zakharovich Kobulov was a Soviet politician and member of the Soviet security (OGPU-NKVD) and police apparatus during and briefly after the Joseph Stalin years, as was his older brother Bogdan Kobulov.
